# LinearProgress

Linear progress indicator

## Overview

- **Category**: feedback
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: LinearProgress

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { LinearProgress } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<LinearProgress variant="determinate" value={50} />
```

## Examples

```tsx
<LinearProgress variant="determinate" value={50} />
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's LinearProgress.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI LinearProgress Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/linearprogress/)
